entities.name: DdrB Q9RY80
observations: The 188-aa query sequence is an exact match to reviewed UniProt Q9RY80, Deinococcus radiodurans single-stranded DNA-binding protein DdrB.

DdrB binds ssDNA rather than dsDNA and stimulates annealing of complementary ssDNA; it contributes to RecA-independent DNA repair and genome reconstitution after severe irradiation-associated fragmentation.
Query Pfam scan identified the DdrB domain PF12747.13 at residues 3–133; predicted mass 20.83 kDa and theoretical pI 8.89.
